# Original libuv timer source

The unmodified `src/timer.c` and repository MIT `LICENSE` are retained
from libuv/libuv. `source-pins.json` binds the exact corpus revision,
complete physical files and independently authored finite obligations.
The original source copyright and permission notice are unchanged.

The regression checks the two written same-file calls in their full
original preprocessing and body context. It does not evaluate includes,
choose preprocessor branches or claim an external `heap_insert` target.
